column1: # Measured surface for s10-skill-recall. See s7-false-completion/surface.tsv
# for why this is a content fingerprint and not a commit SHA.
# This trap measures descriptions, which live in each SKILL.md frontmatter, so
# the whole file is fingerprinted: a body edit that leaves the description
# untouched produces a stale warning, which is the safe direction.
# 2026-08-17: this list is exactly what `build.py` renders the bundle from, and
# `test_the_selection_surface_lists_every_skill_the_bundle_is_built_from` holds
# it there. It used to be hand-kept and went stale by omission - installing
# `evidence-debugging` and `test-first-change` put eight descriptions in front of
# the agent while the fingerprint below still covered six, so a stamp taken then
# would have claimed currency against a surface that was missing two of the
# choices under test. Paths are spelled the way `build.py` reads them; the
# `main/.agents/...` spellings this file used before resolve to the same bytes
# through the symlinks, but only one spelling can be checked for completeness.
# Recompute: evals/scripts/trap-surface.py --trap s10-skill-recall
